title: Wellington Gym Deals
meta_desc: Get the best gym deals in Wellington with discounts, free trials, and subsidies. Compare prices and find the perfect gym for you.
intro: Wellington has a competitive gym market with various deals and discounts available. From budget-friendly options to premium gyms, there's something for everyone. The Exercise NZ subsidy scheme also offers 40-70% off for eligible members.

sections.heading: Current Gym Deals in Wellington
sections.body: Several gyms in Wellington are offering discounts and free trials. Jetts is providing 15% off and 4 weeks free, while Snap Fitness is offering 6 weeks free. Les Mills has introduced a flexi membership with no lock-in contract, and City Fitness is offering a month-to-month membership for $18.99/week.
list: Les Mills: Flexi membership with no lock-in contract

sections.heading: Exercise NZ Subsidy Scheme
sections.body: To be eligible, members must meet certain criteria, such as being a New Zealand citizen or resident, and not having been a member of a gym in the past 12 months.

sections.heading: Best Value Gyms in Wellington
sections.body: City Fitness is currently the best value gym in Wellington, offering a full-service membership for $18.99/week. Les Mills is a premium option with a range of classes and facilities, but it comes at a higher price point.
list: Les Mills: Premium gym with a range of classes and facilities

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips for Joining a Gym in Wellington
sections.body: Here are some tips to help you save money when joining a gym in Wellington: consider a month-to-month membership instead of a long-term contract, look for gyms that offer discounts or free trials, and take advantage of the Exercise NZ subsidy scheme if you're eligible.
list: Look for gyms with discounts or free trials
Take advantage of the Exercise NZ subsidy scheme
Compare prices and find the best value for your money
Read reviews and check the gym's facilities before joining
